user_request: Grenade : explosion de 3x3 et dégâts dégressifs avec la distance à l'épicentre ; examiner cette idée pour les attaques magiques de zone afin de préserver l'intérêt de la mêlée et des tirs physiques.
distance: square_shell_max_abs_dx_abs_dy; corners and cardinal neighbours in the same shell
intermediate_shells: linear between centre and full nominal radius; wall clipping never renormalizes the radius
damage_math_for_review: floor(base_damage * (2*radius - shell_distance) / (2*radius)); radius zero keeps full damage at the centre
proposed_general_scope: Explosive grenades and centred magical damage zones; directional areas, persistent damage and secondary controls require their own reviewed application rule.
visual_source_policy: Reuse grenade and fragmentation source PNGs from review72, blood from accepted review40; no generated bitmap modified.
balancing_limit: Damage falloff reduces damage per peripheral victim but does not limit target count. With full occupancy, an 11x11 at 100 centre / 50 edge still totals 77 full-strength single-target impacts. Costs, cooldown, duration and base damage remain necessary balance variables.
